blurb:
WELCOME TO THE OFFICIAL OBX FILM LOCATIONS TOUR!

Fans of the Netflix series Outer Banks are in for a thrill! 
As a background actor on Season One, Two, Three, Four AND Five! I share tons of behind-the-scenes stories of the cast, crew, and other fun stuff. Tour includes snacks, bottled water, and other surprises. Parents will love this tour because as a licensed tour guide, I share some history while we're traveling from one location to the other. It's such a fun and new way to visit Charleston!

3-hour private tour

MINIMUM 2 GUESTS - MAXIMUM 4 GUESTS (Sorry, no solo travelers.)

Tour vehicle is fully insured for liability and City Certified. 
Luxury SUV
